title: Idle Big Boss
description: Grow a sprawling business empire with effortless idle taps—open shops, hire managers to automate cash flow, and scale from street vendor to billionaire tycoon.
controls: Tap to launch businesses, upgrade storefronts, hire managers, and collect booming cash stacks.

zh-CN.title: 放置大老板
zh-CN.description: 超上头模拟经营放置大老板：开连锁店铺、雇佣金牌店长自动收钱，挂机躺赢一路买楼扩产变身亿万大老板！
zh-CN.controls: 点击开设并升级各类商铺、招募经理自动创收，轻松挂机扩张商业版图。
